{{Quote|Can we have nerfburgers for lunch? With hubba chips?|[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
A '''nerfburger''' was a [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] with ground [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat as the main ingredient. It was typically favored by young people and often served with [[hubba chips]]. They could be purchased from the concession areas of [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment park that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
